product_name: Google Cloud Managed Service for Apache Kafka

features.feature_name: Managed Service for Apache Kafka remote MCP server
features.feature_summary: Remote MCP server enables LLM agents to create and manage Kafka clusters, Kafka Connect clusters, and related resources such as topics, consumer groups, connectors, and ACLs.
features.extended_definition: Remote MCP server enables LLM agents to create and manage Kafka clusters, Kafka Connect clusters, and related resources such as topics, consumer groups, connectors, and ACLs.

features.feature_name: Kafka cluster details in gcloud and the REST API
features.feature_summary: You can view broker node IDs, broker zones, and the Kafka version running on a Managed Service for Apache Kafka cluster.
features.extended_definition: You can view broker node IDs, broker zones, and the Kafka version running on a Managed Service for Apache Kafka cluster.

features.feature_summary: The additionalSubnets field in the ConnectNetworkConfig REST API resource is deprecated; deprecated on 2025-12-08.
features.extended_definition: The additionalSubnets field in the ConnectNetworkConfig REST API resource is deprecated; deprecated on 2025-12-08.

features.feature_summary: Kafka Connect lets you stream data at scale between Managed Service for Apache Kafka clusters and other systems; Managed Service for Apache Kafka supports Kafka Connect with curated built-in connector plugins hosted in Connect clusters.
features.extended_definition: Kafka Connect lets you stream data at scale between Managed Service for Apache Kafka clusters and other systems; Managed Service for Apache Kafka supports Kafka Connect with curated built-in connector plugins hosted in Connect clusters.

features.feature_summary: Managed Service for Apache Kafka integrates with VPC Service Controls; Managed Service for Apache Kafka integrates with VPC Service Controls.
features.extended_definition: Managed Service for Apache Kafka integrates with VPC Service Controls; Managed Service for Apache Kafka integrates with VPC Service Controls.

features.feature_summary: Managed Service for Apache Kafka supports Organization Policy Service custom constraints to restrict specific resource operations.
features.extended_definition: Managed Service for Apache Kafka supports Organization Policy Service custom constraints to restrict specific resource operations.

features.feature_name: mutual TLS authentication for Kafka brokers
features.feature_summary: Mutual TLS lets you use certificate-based authentication with Managed Service for Apache Kafka brokers.
features.extended_definition: Mutual TLS lets you use certificate-based authentication with Managed Service for Apache Kafka brokers.

features.feature_summary: Managed Service for Apache Kafka now supports HIPAA compliance on Google Cloud.
features.extended_definition: Managed Service for Apache Kafka now supports HIPAA compliance on Google Cloud.

features.feature_name: automatic broker scaling and capacity safety checks
features.feature_summary: The service automatically creates new brokers based on cluster memory and vCPU settings and checks broker capacity when a cluster size changes.
features.extended_definition: The service automatically creates new brokers based on cluster memory and vCPU settings and checks broker capacity when a cluster size changes.

features.feature_name: Cloud Monitoring metrics for Managed Service for Apache Kafka
features.feature_summary: Metrics are now available for Managed Service for Apache Kafka resources, with some exceptions.
features.extended_definition: Metrics are now available for Managed Service for Apache Kafka resources, with some exceptions.

features.feature_summary: Managed Service for Apache Kafka now offers schema registry support.
features.extended_definition: Managed Service for Apache Kafka now offers schema registry support.

features.feature_summary: Managed Service for Apache Kafka supports configuring standard Apache Kafka ACLs through REST, gRPC, and gcloud CLI.
features.extended_definition: Managed Service for Apache Kafka supports configuring standard Apache Kafka ACLs through REST, gRPC, and gcloud CLI.

features.feature_name: Kafka data movement with Dataflow templates
features.feature_summary: Managed Service for Apache Kafka supports moving Kafka data to and from Google Cloud services using Dataflow templates.
features.extended_definition: Managed Service for Apache Kafka supports moving Kafka data to and from Google Cloud services using Dataflow templates.
